description: The situation of a remote value: idle, loading, success, empty or error. Each needs its own screen.
A TypeScript union whose members share a literal field (`status`) so the compiler narrows the rest of the shape from it.
A successful request that returned no data. It is not an error and not a loading step.
A combination such as `loading` and `error` both true, which separate booleans allow and a union rules out.
